question: ₹6000 is divided into two parts carrying simple interest at 6% and 11% per annum. After 4 years, the combined interest is ₹2160. Find the ratio of the two investments.

en.question: ₹6000 is divided into two parts carrying simple interest at 6% and 11% per annum. After 4 years, the combined interest is ₹2160. Find the ratio of the two investments.
en.explanation:
Total interest condition
\(x \times 6 \times 4/100 + (6000 - x) \times 11 \times 4/100 = 2160\)
= 2160

Amount at lower rate
\(2400\)
= 2400

Answer = 2:3

question: At simple interest, a business advance amounts to ₹9280 in 2 years and ₹11200 in 5 years. Find the principal.

en.question: At simple interest, a business advance amounts to ₹9280 in 2 years and ₹11200 in 5 years. Find the principal.

One-year interest

= 640

Principal
\(9280 - 640 \times 2\)
= 8000

Answer = ₹8000

Compound amount
\(2000 \times (1 + 25/100)^{3}\)
= 3906.25

Compound interest
\(3906.25 - 2000\)

Rate

Answer = 25% rate
